name: Particle Solidity and Roughness Screening
description:
Perform a shape morphometry analysis to find the 'roughest' particle in the sample image.

1. Open the built-in 'Blobs (25K)' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Blobs (25K)).
2. Configure measurement settings to include 'Solidity', 'Area', and 'Display Label'. Solidity is a measure of surface roughness/irregularity (Area / Convex Area).
3. Threshold the image to create a binary mask (ensure particles are selected, typically black on white or white on black depending on settings).
4. Analyze particles to generate a results table. Filter out small noise (e.g., area < 50 pixels).
5. Identify the single particle with the LOWEST Solidity value (this represents the roughest/most irregular particle).
6. Save the full results table to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/solidity_measurements.csv'.
7. Create a text file '~/ImageJ_Data/results/roughest_particle.txt' containing the Label/ID and the Solidity value of that specific particle (e.g., 'Label: 42, Solidity: 0.785').
